label: North Little River / engraved South Branch confluence
point_definition: Long western tributary meets the northwest main channel; combined river continues southeast before a separate southern tributary and eastward bend.
identity_evidence: The northwestern approach bends south into a clearly drawn junction. The long western branch has the same broad upstream northward bow; the joined channel goes southeast to a separate southern tributary, then bends east. Source labels North Branch, South Branch and Little River corroborate the topology. The western reference tributary has a blank name field, so no modern South Branch name is asserted. The crosshair is on the three-way water-line convergence, separate from lettering and the downstream road crossing.
phase: Fresh independent validation of frozen TPS13; excluded from fitting and selection
